Specification: This module defines a helper extension around BinarySearch by introducing a bounded-sequence constructor. It extends BinarySearch, declares the constant MaxSeqLen, assumes MaxSeqLen is a natural number, and defines LimitedSeq(S) as the union of all function spaces [1 .. n -> S] for n in 1 .. MaxSeqLen.
